label: Gulf War undiagnosed illness and chronic multisymptom illness
authority: Persian Gulf War Veterans' Benefits Act
presumptiveConditions: Functional gastrointestinal disorders (including irritable bowel syndrome)
Undiagnosed illness with muscle or joint pain
notes: For Gulf War Veterans, qualifying chronic symptoms and defined illnesses can be presumptively service connected even without a known cause. These claims generally do not need a nexus letter.
